name: Willem de Groot
headline: Senior DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer
summary: Senior DevOps/SRE engineer with 8 years of experience designing and operating scalable cloud infrastructure. Specialized in Kubernetes orchestration, Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, and AWS cloud architecture. Strong background in CI/CD automation, observability, and improving system reliability across distributed environments.

responsibilities: Lead the design and maintenance of Kubernetes clusters supporting multi-tenant production workloads
Define and enforce Terraform module standards for AWS infrastructure provisioning
Drive incident response processes and improve system observability using Prometheus and Grafana
Mentor junior engineers on cloud-native best practices and infrastructure automation
Collaborate with development teams to optimize deployment pipelines and reduce release cycle time
Migrated legacy on-premise applications to AWS using containerized deployments
Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and GitLab CI
Automated infrastructure provisioning using Terraform and Ansible
Implemented monitoring and alerting solutions to improve system uptime
Supported production troubleshooting and capacity planning
Assisted in maintaining Linux server infrastructure for internal applications
Wrote automation scripts to streamline routine operational tasks
Participated in on-call rotations supporting production systems
Contributed to documentation of deployment and configuration procedures
